reviews.title: Glitched?
reviews.text: Using app for guest list and RSVP. The app keeps removing last names and changing full name to either as first name or last name. It’s been creating problems with guests trying to RSVP. Absolutely terrible, not worth the chaos. We have enough stress as it is. Would not recommend.

reviews.title: Not good
reviews.text: I kinda wish i started with the knot instead. This web and all is super glitchy. When i click on any of the bottom options it just refreshes and never loads. Been like this for months. Like the developers don’t make updates or fix bugs regularly. Use a different site for your wedding!

reviews.title: Terrible experience
reviews.text: This app was a complete nightmare to use. They will make it incredibly difficult to get any money you get out., their customer service will take days to respond to you, they will charge your guest $15 to send you a generic AI generated thank you card, and everything on their registry is insanely overpriced. And it gets better., if they can’t fulfill the order, guess what they don’t give you or your family or friends your money back, they give you a credit to use at their shady aforementioned “store”. This has caused me so much stress, during one of the most stressful times of my life, so I am seeing this with my full chest, DO NOT USE this app or site!!!! save yourself the headache and find a place that actually values you, your time, and the money of the people who get you gifts

reviews.title: Worst wedding app
reviews.text: Super confusing, slow, and hard to manage. Been a huge headache.

reviews.title: Complex interface with Fake Data Hard to remove
reviews.text:
At first it seems like it’s easier to navigate than The Knot and allows me to directly add my unlisted venue. I even like that guests can upload their own date via a link but the ease stops there. 
For whatever reason they have dummy account data instead of blank areas like fake contacts and wedding party info. It would be only mildly annoying if it could simply be deleted but from the app that’s impossible. You have to do the bulk of your editing on your computer via the site. Top that off with it being nearly impossible to remove from there as well. I just wanted a nice planner app. If I wanted to jump through hoops I’d have just built it myself. Deleting and trying something else.

reviews.title: Couples Beware
reviews.text: This has to be one of the worst app designs on the App Store. They sent us items that were previously opened and returned. When we contacted support, it took more than a week to even get a message response. Imagine having to go back and forth between THREE MESSAGES. It takes near three weeks to actually complete anything. You’re better off making a registry on Zola or The Knot.

reviews.title: Unable to view registry
reviews.text: Can’t even view my registry on the app anymore. It just shows an error message.

reviews.title: Horrid Registry Experience
reviews.text: Their website and planning features are okay, but their registry is awful. $50 “bulk item surcharge”?? I don’t know any place that charges $50 to ship a vacuum, that’s robbery! Also price matching is like pulling teeth. Go elsewhere.

reviews.title: “Free App”
reviews.text: This app asks for money around every feature that takes time to put together then at the last moment they tell you it’s going to cost $80. You cannot even message the guest list without paying $80. Look elsewhere for a wedding website.

reviews.title: Terrible app
reviews.text: Crashes all the time. Interface is so limited. Lists of guests are not in alphabetical order.

reviews.title: Buggy
reviews.text: Not able to use any of it. Can’t share creation of guest list or update photos.

reviews.title: Not user friendly
reviews.text: Incredibly difficult to navigate through, confusing, have to log in to access anything and even rsvp multiple times.

reviews.title: Please Fix INVITE Feature
reviews.text: Overall, I love how I can organize the schedule and also offer hotels as a part of the tab automatically however, the invite feature is like biting nails. It is so annoying how I have to go through the list of invites that I can purchase instead of the invitation that I already purchased to send to guest, unless I’m on desktop, which is still a bit of a hassle.

reviews.title: Don’t Recommend
reviews.text: Very glitchy. The app kept freezing and then deleted all of my progress.

reviews.title: REGISTRY IS SCAM
reviews.text: DO NOT USE THIS COMPANY FOR YOUR REGISTRY. Cash funds are mysteriously still pending, many of our gifts are “out of stock” and so we are issued joy credit that can only be used in their joy store. I don’t want another item, I want the items that my loved ones chose for me. I am telling everyone I know to not use this company.

reviews.title: Guest list feels impossible to use
reviews.text:
I’m having a few issues with the guest page. It’s very difficult to add couples and families together, and the page that opens doesn’t function properly. I can’t scroll to see all the guests, and whenever I click on a name and then try to go back, it closes everything and I have to start over.

The widget also keeps taking me to a random couple’s RSVP, and I have to sign in again every time I try to use it. It says you can add tags to guests, but when I do, they don’t actually save.

The app has a lot of potential and some great features, but the bugs make it frustrating to use. If these issues were fixed, it would be a great app.

reviews.title: App having trouble
reviews.text: Love this app but it’s been having issues. I don’t know if updated or something but it doesn’t load any of my things.

reviews.title: New Update :(
reviews.text:
I like that it’s faster but the guest list feature stopped working and adding our total responses…

Loved it before the update but now our favorite feature is gone

reviews.title: Not Usable
reviews.text: The website works great, but I can’t do anything on this app. The webpage editing function in particular just reloads over and over.

reviews.title: Do not try creating website
reviews.text: Awful. Cant even upload photos clicking upload button does nothing

reviews.title: Joy Created the Problem — Then Contradicted the Refund
reviews.text:
This was one of the worst third-party booking experiences we have ever dealt with.

Our flight was canceled due to maintenance issues, so we responsibly contacted BOTH the hotel and Joy Travel Concierge to inform them that we would simply be arriving ONE DAY LATE.

The hotel understood this perfectly when we spoke with them directly.

Unfortunately, after we separately contacted Joy with the exact same information, a Joy representative apparently contacted the hotel and incorrectly informed them that we would not be arriving at all.

Because of Joy’s incorrect communication, the hotel canceled our ENTIRE reservation.

Let that sink in:
The hotel only canceled our stay after Joy contacted them and communicated inaccurate information.

Had Joy not made that call, our reservation would never have been canceled in the first place.

So after an already stressful travel disruption, we arrived at the property only to discover:
• our reservation had been canceled,
• our original room was gone,
• and we had to scramble with hotel staff for accommodations because of a mistake caused by the booking intermediary itself.

We were eventually downgraded from the king room we originally booked and paid for.

To the hotel manager’s credit, she acknowledged the situation, waived parking fees because of the inconvenience, and informed us she would approve a refund for the unused first night.

Then things became even more concerning.

reviews.title: Maybe it’s just me
reviews.text: This has been wonky, I can’t do anything in the app. I can’t edit the site, change colors, or anything.

reviews.title: Very very disappointed with registry
reviews.text: This website is not only a pain to navigate, but the registry makes zero sense. I’ve had 5 different items purchased by family for our registry and every single was out of stock. Why allow the item to be added to your registry if it is out of stock? Sure they send you “credit” but it can only be used for items added from joy, so if you added another registry to your website it won’t work. I’m continually looking for items to use with my credit but ITS ALL SOLD OUT.

reviews.title: No login button???
reviews.text: Login button is blank and I cannot click it, please fix this!

reviews.title: Limited functions in-app and very glitchy
reviews.text: It has very little functionality so keep sending you to a browser for most of the things you want to do. Often it needs to be a computer browser, and things glitch a lot. It has very unintuitive UI. That’s been quite annoying for the last few weeks, and now the app’s frozen altogether and can’t do anything.

reviews.title: It works but barely
reviews.text: I would not recommend it to anyone planning a wedding unless "free" is important which by the time you're paying for a wedding, may as well pay for that too. The user experience on the web app is absolute garbage. For example, on the web app the default pages cannot be deleted, the items on the schedule cannot be ordered without adding times and if you remove the times it randomly shuffles the order, copy+pasting rich text into textboxes pastes wildly wrong with no way to fix it, flows are flat out counter-intuitive or bizarre, load times are long, all kinds of seemingly basic features are missing or you're forced to invent workarounds to do whatever you're trying to do. I could go on but the take-home is to save yourself a headache and pay for a real no-code website tool.

reviews.title: SUPER slow app/website
reviews.text: I’ll start by saying I love the interface and it was super easy to use and plan my wedding with, but the app and website are INCREDIBLY slow. Like, the slowest app I’ve ever used. I never review apps and I felt so strongly after 4 months that I’m so bothered by it I need to review it. I had a hard time viewing the registry, even as a guest. It sometimes crashes my phone because the app is so slow.

reviews.title: App not loading
reviews.text: Anyone that experiencing the app just spinning and not actually loading? I’ve uninstalled and reinstalled just to have the same thing happen again.

reviews.title: Not loading
reviews.text: Installed but does not load

reviews.title: Baby Registry feature leaves a lot to be desired
reviews.text: I tried using Joy’s baby registry feature, and was very disappointed. The options of items to add from the Joy store seemed limited, a lot of friends/family reported that trying to purchase from the registry was difficult or confusing, and when it came time to use the completion discount, I got conflicting information about what would be eligible based on when it was added to the registry. The terms said anything added before the event date, then customer service said items had to be added within 30 days of the event. I would recommend finding another site to use for baby registries.

reviews.title: Love it, but buggy
reviews.text:
This app was actually so helpful for invites, but they rarely update it I feel. My issue right now is that it won’t even let me delete guests who aren’t coming, making my numbers completely wrong!! I get an error message when I try, and the button isn’t lined up properly so you have to click it weird. 
It’s also very annoying to operate on a mobile phone. Glitches out lots and unsaves data so you have to redo it a few times and pray haha.
So yes, it’s good! But please fix the bugs!!

reviews.title: Garbage app and garbage website
reviews.text: The website DELETED a bunch of my addresses and names!!! This site has really screwed me, it barely works, impossible to navigate. I regret choosing this site so much, never ever use this I beg of you. Unless you want to try and track down which names and addresses it deleted!!!

reviews.title: Rubbish
reviews.text: There were random people on my guest list and the app wouldn’t let me delete them, I’m assuming they are examples but when I tried to edit them it still messed up and wouldn’t save to the new edit. Drove me mad

reviews.title: Do not use!!!!
reviews.text: Incredibly difficult! My fiancee and I have had to correct every single invite. I would only recommend using the app if you want to waste an incredible amount of your time!

reviews.title: Glitches daily
reviews.text: This app glitches daily when I try to edit my guest list. Very annoying. You also can’t filter out the guest list and see only people who’ve RSVPd. You also can’t send out blast messages to guests. Just overall not the greatest app.

reviews.title: Glitchy
reviews.text: Cannot remove template guests as there is a glitch with the drop down boxes making it impossible to use the app on both new iPad and iPhone 17 pro max. Can use the desktop version to do it but app is not effective to use on its own and has too many bugs.

reviews.title: Always buggy
reviews.text: The UX/UI is so confusing and I work in technology. We continued to run into bugs. You need a good amount of time to just get used to the interface. We had so many issues navigating the interface and trying to get things organized, our guests still asked a ton of questions cause they couldnt find things. The backend is sooooooo overbuilt. And if you are really trying to do a digital wedding you want text messaging. Can’t do that here. They are first a registry more than anything and everything is marked up! So if your guest purchase from there they are paying the highest dollar. There were a few cool things but with how stressful wedding planning is already pick a simple platform and sometime with text.

reviews.title: Horrible app!
reviews.text: This app has the worst customer service! I’ve been trying to delete the app for almost a month now. The live chat button doesn’t work, I found something after spending an hour scrolling through the app that say delete account. I clicked on it , it said type delete, I typed delete and clicked the check mark I  finally was able to get a hold of a AI chat room that put me on hold for 30 minutes just for the app to glitch and not be able to talk to a human.DO NOT DOWNLOAD THIS APP! If you have any problems or questions you will never be able to talk to a human. Also it takes up a lot of space on my phone.

reviews.title: Useless app
reviews.text: This app can’t do anything useful. It doesn’t let you modify contact list, it screws up number formatting when you upload contacts, you can’t send save the dates from it. I honestly don’t get the point of the app. What’s more aggravating is that you’re REQUIRED to have a desktop to do certain things since it doesn’t let you do it on app or mobile website. This company spends way more on marketing than r&d.

reviews.title: Non functional
reviews.text: The website is Ok, if a bit slow. But the app is unbearable. It continuously shows an error when trying to view the guest list, after 5-10 refreshes it sometimes works, but most of the time doesn’t. I am on WiFi. Terrible

reviews.title: Terrible Experience
reviews.text: Perplexed how this rates so highly. The UX is shocking. Changes are lost, templates don’t save, trying to figure out the basics is extremely difficult. Much easier to email a Canva template and hyperlink to a Google form. Don’t put yourself through the stress of this!

reviews.title: Read trust pilot reviews
reviews.text: Horrible reviews

reviews.title: Force me to use it and doesn’t work
reviews.text: The website force me to use it from mobile and it barely has same functionalities. I can’t edit guest lists right now, at least allow me to use website even if UI isn’t perfect

reviews.title: Doesn’t function
reviews.text: It won’t open anything. Just keeps spinning.

reviews.title: App Never Loads!
reviews.text: The app downloads, but I just get a spinning wheel of death when I open it, eventually it will ask me to log in, when I tap that button, the screen goes white and the wheel reappears but never clears. The guest list is also impossible to view on mobile which means I can only manage my event on my desktop, very not user friendly!
